question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0449ea2bee0af370a2632f0d0b109b735e9f855f2d5be1884687745f867fd02b.png]
solution:
The image that replaces the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :-

 
• The dot present in cross lines moves one step anti-clockwise from figure to figure.
 
• The triangle present in cross lines moves one step clockwise from figure to figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89e0f7063cc73d67a338403cd7447d5ef5d684ea4ba70fda24a3e336832d1d41.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
